title: Would You Rather: The Creepy Version (Every Choice Has a Catch) #shorts #wouldyourather
description:
Every choice has a catch. Which one would you survive?

#wouldyourather #scary #quiz #shorts

questions.a: Hear knocking every night at 3 AM
questions.b: Find a new photo of yourself sleeping every morning
questions.a_catch: The knocking is coming from inside your closet.

questions.a: Live in a house where the lights never turn off
questions.b: Live in a house where the doors never lock
questions.b_catch: Something already knows the doors don't lock.

questions.a: Always know when someone is lying
questions.b: Always know when someone is behind you
questions.a_catch: Everyone lies to you about one thing: that you're alone.

outro: A or B? Comment your picks.
